name: s73-stop-gate-broken-python3-still-blocks
notes: python3 on PATH is the macOS stub that only prints an xcode-select note and exits 1. The summary said failed, but stop-gate read it through that python3, got nothing and allowed the stop. python3 is now probed by running it; a failing one counts as absent, so the jq / bash readers are used — and a reader that errors blocks.
